name: VA-10
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+6 district with strong Democratic fundamentals
Prediction markets price D win at 94-96%
First-term incumbent with no polling available
model.rationale: The baseline model and fundamentals point to a Safe D seat, and prediction markets at 94-96% plus a lopsided money advantage confirm it. I stay near the baseline with a slight trim for the absence of polling and a first-term incumbent.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing a single-digit race or major outside Republican spending would warrant a downgrade to Likely D.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Northern Virginia's 10th District leans Democratic by about six points, and first-term incumbent Suhas Subramanyam is seeking reelection with the advantages of incumbency and a dominant financial position. He has raised roughly $1.17 million and holds $583,000 on hand, while Republican Dave Beckwith has raised about $107,000. Outside spending favors the Democrat modestly, and no polling is available for the general election.

With no expert ratings and no surveys, the forecast rests on district fundamentals, the favorable national environment implied by the model, and prediction markets that price a Democratic win at 94 to 96 percent. The result is a Safe Democratic rating with a wide but manageable uncertainty band.
